lesson: [2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] For the audited Beat Saber conversion and ridge recipe, causal event AP was 0.170 versus shifted-target null 0.131 and beat-trigger scene novelty 0.150, missing both frozen margin gates (+0.039 versus required +0.15; +0.020 versus required +0.05); the reported offline arm still missed the shift margin. The hazard-conditioned neural head improved over its rhythm baseline, but the audio-only head did not show a positive margin, so that partial result does not replace the failed preregistered corpus-eligibility comparisons. xLights was not audited because access was blocked, and the tested Beat Saber component's Stage 9 loss exclusion neither refutes xLights or all authored-light corpora nor establishes human or physical LIGHT qualification.
